payload.description: A published target for the allocations scheme itself. The council measures how long a home stands empty and how much rent it collects, but nothing it publishes sets a target for how long someone waits on the housing register, how many people move out of each priority band, or what the two-year residence rule introduced in 2026 has done to the register. The scheme's own equality assessment commits the council to reviewing its impact in February 2027.
